articles.title: Clonal memory of cell division in humans diverges between healthy haematopoiesis and acute myeloid leukaemia
articles.description: Healthy blood stem and progenitor cells display synchronised division across generations — a form of clonal memory lost in AML. A bromodomain inhibitor partially restores it, revealing a potential epigenetic vulnerability in leukaemia.
